models.composition: Solomon and the Queen of Sheba
models.qualification: Uploader describes an iPhone13 capture at the Florence Baptistery. Frontal thumbnail identifies a distinct relief composition, subject to final source and primary scene verification. Captured installed Gates of Paradise panel is a 1990 exterior bronze replica after Lorenzo Ghiberti, produced by Frilli Gallery; the Renaissance originals are in the Museo dell’Opera del Duomo. Relief/front detail scope: not an entire door or a complete physical panel back. Current eligible CC BY4.0 grant/publisher are verified separately. Native capture integrity and exact authenticated GLB bytes/hash remain pending.
